the content block, mostly the 10-gram sums of word categories. I followed the description's "summed" literally rather than adjusting for this.

I stopped after one run instead of adjusting the model to close the gap, because the goal was faithfulness rather than matching the score.

Final model: **rec-arc-content-v1**
